verification: Official migrations reproduced these exact trigger/function fingerprints in PGlite PostgreSQL 18 and matched read-only PostgreSQL 17 metadata from the DEV project. Provider updates require explicit baseline review.

triggers.name: protect_objects_delete
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER protect_objects_delete BEFORE DELETE ON storage.objects FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION storage.protect_delete()

triggers.name: update_objects_updated_at
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER update_objects_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON storage.objects FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION storage.update_updated_at_column()
